task.name: twelve-screen-final-mockups
task.goal: Freeze an original, implementation-ready mobile visual and interaction specification for canonical screens S01-S12, including normal, pending, recovery and critical failure states, without implementing production runtime, backend, payment, ads or Production publication.
completionMayNotBeClaimedFrom: placeholder art presented as production art

copyingForbidden: competitor names or exact UI placement
competitor art, icons, probabilities or prices
treating reference mockups as already approved production assets

canonicalScreens.name: title-resume-account
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Start, resume or recover the correct account and save state without hiding link, migration or deletion consequences.

canonicalScreens.name: battle-follow
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Understand current floor, four-cat battle causality, next useful action, support arrival and settlement state within five seconds.

canonicalScreens.name: unbounded-tower
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Understand current floor, best floor, district, 100F cycle and next milestone without implying a final maximum floor.

canonicalScreens.name: floor-clear-choice
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Show the clear reward and one-time support, rescue or shop choice with an explicit choose-later path.

canonicalScreens.name: shop-delivery
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Compare persistent shop and delivery configurations by visible combat impact without mandatory manual collection or replenishment.

canonicalScreens.name: character
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Separate base rarity, uncapped coin level, evolution stage, character mastery and party slot while making first-copy functionality explicit.

canonicalScreens.name: weapon-build
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Equip one weapon per permanent character, compare build impact and mastery, and explain overflow without random-substat clutter.

canonicalScreens.name: boss
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Expose phase, telegraph, break window, failure diagnosis, retry and one-time reward with clear battle causality.

canonicalScreens.name: tower-return
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Show every loss, retained asset, ruby grant and reclear forecast before the single irreversible tower-return confirmation.

canonicalScreens.name: recruit-gacha
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Keep character and weapon banners separated and disclose odds, pity, featured guarantee, carryover, exchange, duplicate conversion and history before drawing.

canonicalScreens.name: store-ruby-ads
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Distinguish paid and free ruby, exact product contents, purchase state, refund deficit, rewarded-ad opt-in and entitlement restoration without deceptive urgency.

canonicalScreens.name: login-inbox
canonicalScreens.primaryOutcome: Present newcomer, monthly and returner campaigns, server-time eligibility, inbox, claim history and missed-day behavior without false streak pressure.

principles: Cats, battle, tower and growth are visually primary.
Use original moonlit indigo, warm brass, parchment and jewel accents rather than copying the reference layouts.
Use tower arches, paw sigils, stained-glass geometry and delivery-route motifs as Cat's Tower-specific identity.
Reserve red for destructive or failed states and green for confirmed positive settlement, not generic decoration.
One dominant action per screen; secondary actions remain visually subordinate.
Monetization, gacha and login details do not remain permanently visible on the battle screen.
Normal, pending and recovery states share the same information hierarchy rather than replacing outcomes with generic spinners.
prohibitedPatterns: always-on store or gacha promotion on S02
tiny gold text on brown panels
decorative frames consuming the safe area
reward claims that conceal server time, cap or immutable offer version
reset, draw or purchase timeout presented as definite failure

fiveSecondComprehension: failure or pending reason when applicable

roles: mobile information hierarchy and five-second comprehension
economy, gacha, reset and purchase disclosure
repository evidence, originality and implementation handoff

failureConditions: Any canonical screen S01-S12 is missing or merged into another screen.
Any primary screenshot is missing at 320x667, 375x667 or 390x844.
Essential content is clipped, overlapped by safe areas or requires horizontal scrolling.
A required economic operation lacks pending and recovery presentation.
Character and weapon gacha are visually or logically merged into one ordinary pool.
S09 omits any loss, retained asset, ruby grant or reclear forecast.
S11 obscures paid/free provenance, product contents, refund deficit or opt-in ad terms.
S02 makes store, gacha or login the visual protagonist.
Reference images are traced or presented as owned final assets.
Any unresolved P0 or P1 remains after independent review.
Runtime, backend, provider settings, Production alias or physical-iPhone PASS are changed or claimed during Step 4.

allowed: dedicated Step 4 verification workflow and tests

completionRule: Step 4 may become PASS only after source, all renders, state coverage, rendered self-audit, five independent critics, fixes, regression, exact commit/tree/workflow binding, synchronized current-state mirrors and terminal live read-back all pass with unresolved P0/P1 equal to zero.
